_meta.description: Court formatting rules — drives cause-title, party designations, prayer language, verification format
_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE COURT OF DISTRICT JUDGE / CIVIL JUDGE (SENIOR DIVISION)
jurisdictionNote: Civil court of original jurisdiction. Handles suits, consumer complaints (District Commission), rent disputes, and other civil matters within the district.

party_designation.state: State through the Collector / District Magistrate, {district}

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And any other relief which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case may also be granted in favour of the plaintiff.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby verify that the contents of the above plaint/application are true and correct to my knowledge. The documents annexed herewith are true copies of their respective originals.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: Plaints must comply with Order VII Rule 1 CPC — full particulars of the claim.
Court fee to be affixed as per state court fees schedule.
All documents relied upon to be filed with the plaint (Order VII Rule 14 CPC).
Valuation of suit to be clearly stated for pecuniary jurisdiction.
Written statements to be filed within 30 days of service of summons (extendable to 120 days).
